page.overview:
What is Kodachi Swords?

Kodachi Swords are Skarlet's main weapon in Mortal Kombat (2011). They are generally dual-wielded, and are considered shorter versions of the Ninja Sword or Katana. (quite similar to a Tanto.) They are meant to cut quick and powerfully, and be sheathed before anyone knows what hit them. The sheathes are located on Skarlet's lower back.
